name: ai-lifesim-studio
description: Plugin for making family life-sim games on a fixed Godot kernel, one theme pack per game. Has pack-authoring skills for places and props, the action table, livelihoods, wishes and mood, old stories, births and generations, seasons and weather, pets, the art skin and verification, learned from building 《起家》, plus art, UI, release and writing skills borrowed from AI RPG Studio. The producer workflow is still to come. 生活模拟游戏（家庭、小人、房子、几代人）的插件：排房子、编行为表、营生、心愿与心情、旧事、生育与代际、季节天气、宠物、美术皮、验收这几个填主题包的技能来自《起家》的实际开发；美术、界面、发布、文风借自 AI RPG Studio。制作人流程还没做。
